concepts.def: Conflict between communist North (Kim Il-sung) and US-backed South; UN forces under MacArthur; ended at 38th parallel.
Revolt led by Imre Nagy against Soviet control; crushed in November when Khrushchev sent 200,000 troops and tanks.
Built by GDR on 13 August to stop East Germans fleeing; symbol of Iron Curtain until fall on 9 November 1989.
Dubcek's reforms in Czechoslovakia ('socialism with a human face') crushed by Warsaw Pact invasion in August.
1968 Soviet policy justifying intervention to defend socialism in any Warsaw Pact country threatened by reform.
USSR's invasion to support communist regime; defeated by US-armed Mujahideen, weakening Soviet economy and morale.
